title: Merge Sorted Array
description: You are given two integer arrays nums1 and nums2, sorted in non-decreasing order, and two integers m and n representing the number of elements in nums1 and nums2. Merge nums2 into nums1 as one sorted array in-place. nums1 has enough space (length m + n) to hold the result.
